Palette/style reference image only; do NOT repeat the reference icon in each frame. EXACTLY 8 consecutive animation frames arranged FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows, row-major reading order. Landscape sprite sheet, square occupied artwork fitting each cell, no text or grid lines. Each frame has the SAME camera, centre/anchor and world scale; maintain 15 percent transparent margins INSIDE EACH CELL, no crossing cell borders. An infernal-free STORM CORONATION seal: three elegant broken dark-grey wind rings spiral around an EMPTY centre, small white electrical spokes briefly bridge the rings, four cloud-scroll accents rotate. Eight equal-size cyclic charge phases to be pulsed/scaled in code during transcendence. Flat oblique ground perspective, no physical crown/pawn/landscape, no solid disk. Flat cel-shaded hand-painted crisp game effects, sculpted dark-grey clouds (#34363c, #555861), silver-grey wind ribbons and narrow WHITE electricity only. Strong clean shapes, minimal bloom. Every cell contains a visible distinct frame. Preserve true transparency between and outside shapes. No black/white/grey background rectangle, checkerboard pattern, colored light, floor shadow, backdrop, smoke haze blanket, text, labels, numbers, characters or buildings. This is a compositing sprite atlas, NOT a lit scene. ABSOLUTELY NO ambient grey veil, bloom, halo glow, gradient wash, fog blanket or cast shadows. Every empty space BETWEEN ribbons and in holes must be alpha ZERO. Only solid matte cloud/ribbon shapes, white lines and their antialiased edge pixels may have opacity. Ignore all ambient glow in the palette reference.
